modal.cta: I want this on my project

nuxt.about: Nuxt orchestrates Vue with SSR/SSG, file routing and conventions that speed up production apps.
steps: You write Vue pages and components in the project structure.
Nuxt resolves routes, data fetching and rendering (SSR/SPA) automatically.
The build outputs an optimized app ready to deploy and scale.

vue.about: Vue builds UIs from reactive components: state changes and the interface updates predictably.
steps: Components encapsulate template, state and logic.
Reactivity tracks dependencies and re-renders only what’s needed.
The component tree builds the full user experience.
uses: Modern web UIs and design systems
Products with smooth UX and simple maintenance

react.about: React describes UI as a function of state: you declare what to show, it reconciles the DOM.
steps: Components return visual structure from props and state.
The reconciler computes the minimal diff between renders.
Hooks and ecosystem cover data, routing and forms.
uses: Apps with a mature library ecosystem

typescript.about: TypeScript adds static types to JavaScript to catch errors early and document contracts.
steps: You type functions, APIs and domain models.
The compiler validates code before it runs.
IDE and refactors stay safer on large codebases.
uses: APIs and frontends with clear contracts
Shared code across teams without surprises

flutter.about: Flutter draws UI with widgets and its own engine, shipping native cross-platform apps.
steps: The widget tree describes layouts and interaction.
The Skia/Impeller engine renders with native performance.
One codebase ships iOS, Android and, when it fits, web/desktop.
uses: Products that need fast dual-store delivery

figma.about: Figma is the collaborative canvas where product, design and engineering align the interface.
steps: Designers create frames, components and tokens.
The team comments, versions and validates flows together.
Engineers export specs and implement the design system.

tailwind.about: Tailwind styles via utilities in markup, speeding up consistent UI without sprawling CSS.
steps: Utility classes express spacing, color and typography.
Purge removes unused styles at build time.
Theme tokens keep brand alignment in the product.

vite.about: Vite serves with native ESM in dev and bundles with Rollup in production — near-instant HMR.
steps: In development, modules load on demand.
HMR updates only what changed, without a full reload.
Production build outputs optimized bundles.

pinia.about: Pinia is Vue’s official store: typed global state, clear actions and great DX.
steps: You define stores by domain (auth, cart, session).
Components read state and dispatch actions.
Persistence and plugins cover advanced cases.

playwright.about: Playwright drives real browsers to validate end-to-end flows with stability.
steps: The test opens Chromium, Firefox or WebKit.
Actions and asserts simulate a real user.
Traces and screenshots help debug failures.

vitest.about: Vitest runs unit tests in the Vite ecosystem: fast, familiar and bundler-aligned.
steps: You write specs next to the code.
The runner executes in watch with HMR-like feedback.
Coverage and mocks cover business logic.
uses: Fast CI in the front pipeline

vercel.about: Vercel ships frontends and edge functions with PR previews and a global CDN.
steps: A git push triggers build and preview.
Assets go to the edge; serverless covers light APIs.
Production updates with simple rollback.

nodejs.about: Node.js runs JavaScript on the server — ideal for APIs, workers and BFFs.
steps: The event loop processes I/O without blocking.
You expose HTTP routes or work queues.
Libs and runtime share the same JS ecosystem.
uses: BFF between front and internal services

nestjs.about: NestJS structures Node APIs with modules, DI and typing — enterprise patterns with speed.
steps: Modules isolate domain (auth, billing, users).
Controllers receive HTTP; services hold business rules.
Guards, pipes and interceptors standardize security and validation.

python.about: Python shines in automation, data and security: clear scripts and a rich ecosystem.
steps: You model logic in readable modules.
Libs cover HTTP, parsing, crypto and ML.
It runs as CLIs, APIs (FastAPI) or analysis pipelines.

go.about: Go delivers concurrent services and simple binaries — great for infra and low-latency APIs.
steps: Goroutines handle lightweight concurrency.
The compiler produces a single binary.
Deploy stays predictable in containers or VMs.

postgresql.about: PostgreSQL is the robust relational database: ACID, JSON, extensions and mature performance.
steps: Schemas model entities and relations.
Queries and indexes deliver consistent reads.
Transactions ensure integrity under load.

redis.about: Redis keeps data in memory for cache, queues and sessions with minimal latency.
steps: The app writes keys with TTL or structures (list, set).
Hot reads avoid hitting the primary database.
Pub/Sub and streams cover light messaging.

mongodb.about: MongoDB stores flexible documents — useful when schemas evolve quickly.
steps: JSON/BSON documents represent entities.
Indexes speed up frequent queries.
Aggregations process analytics in the database itself.

prisma.about: Prisma is a type-safe ORM: the schema generates a typed client and predictable migrations.
steps: You declare models in the Prisma schema.
Migrations sync the database.
The typed client queries with autocomplete and safety.

docker.about: Docker packages app + deps into images — the same artifact runs everywhere.
steps: The Dockerfile describes the image.
Build produces cacheable layers.
Containers run isolated in dev, CI and production.

kubernetes.about: Kubernetes orchestrates containers: scale, heal and roll out without constant manual work.
steps: Pods and services declare desired load.
The control plane reconciles actual state.
Rollouts and HPA adjust capacity on demand.

terraform.about: Terraform defines infra as code: networks, databases and permissions versioned in git.
steps: You declare resources in HCL.
Plan shows the diff before applying.
Apply creates/updates the cloud repeatably.

aws.about: AWS provides compute, data, networking and security on demand — the default cloud backbone.
steps: Services (EC2, ECS, S3, RDS…) are composed.
IAM controls who accesses what.
Observability and redesign cover continuous operations.
uses: Secure architectures with IAM and VPC

linux.about: Linux underpins servers, containers and labs — hardening and operations start here.
steps: Processes, networking and permissions form the runtime.
You harden SSH, firewall and packages.
Logs and auditing support incident response.

kali.about: Kali Linux packs the offensive toolkit for ethical pentest and controlled audits.
steps: The lab boots with preinstalled tools.
Recon, exploit and post-exploitation follow methodology.
Findings become evidence and a report.

burp.about: Burp Suite intercepts and mutates HTTP traffic to find flaws in web apps.
steps: The proxy captures requests/responses.
Repeater and Intruder test payloads.
Scanner and extensions widen coverage.

metasploit.about: Metasploit organizes exploits and payloads to prove a vulnerability is truly exploitable.
steps: You pick the module that fits the target.
Payload and session measure impact.
The result feeds the risk report.

wireshark.about: Wireshark dissects network packets to understand protocols, latency and anomalies.
steps: Capture collects traffic on the interface.
Filters isolate conversations and protocols.
Analysis spots misconfig, leaks or attacks.

owasp.about: OWASP is the reference for application security risks and best practices.
steps: Top 10 and ASVS maps guide the scope.
Controls are applied across the SDLC.
Retests measure risk reduction.

vault.about: HashiCorp Vault stores secrets and issues dynamic credentials with audit trails.
steps: Secrets stay centralized and encrypted.
Policies define who can read what.
Dynamic credentials rotate automatically.
uses: Least-privilege access to DBs and APIs

grafana.about: Grafana visualizes metrics, logs and traces for operations and fast response.
steps: Sources (Prometheus, Loki…) are connected.
Dashboards show system health.
Alerts fire when an SLO breaks.

prometheus.about: Prometheus scrapes time-series metrics with pull and alerting rules.
steps: Exporters expose service metrics.
The server scrapes and stores series.
Alertmanager notifies on anomalies.

keycloak.about: Keycloak centralizes identity: SSO, OAuth2/OIDC and user federation.
steps: Realms and clients model apps and tenants.
OIDC flows authenticate the user.
Roles and policies authorize access.
uses: Modern auth for products and APIs

cloudflare.about: Cloudflare protects and accelerates at the edge: CDN, WAF, DDoS and Zero Trust.
steps: DNS points traffic to the edge.
WAF and rules filter threats.
Cache and Workers improve performance.

openssl.about: OpenSSL implements TLS/SSL and certificate utilities — practical cryptography foundations.
steps: Generates keys and CSRs.
Negotiates TLS handshakes in services.
Validates chains and encrypts data in transit.

features.headline: Services
features.title: From code to compliance.
features.description: A full catalog from both departments, software engineering and information security, using the names the market knows.

items.title: Frontend Development
items.description: Modern, responsive web interfaces with Vue, React and Nuxt. Focus on performance, accessibility, design systems and continuous delivery.

items.title: Mobile Development
items.description: Native and cross-platform apps for iOS and Android, with API integration, notifications, auth and a smooth production experience.

items.title: Backend and APIs
items.description: REST and GraphQL APIs, microservices, authentication, queues and databases. Scalable, observable architecture ready to grow.

items.title: DevOps and Cloud
items.description: CI/CD pipelines, containers, infrastructure as code and cloud environments such as AWS, with monitoring and secure deploys.

items.title: Software Architecture
items.description: Solution design, legacy modernization and integration patterns, with technical decisions aligned to cost, timeline and security.

items.title: UX/UI and Digital Product
items.description: Flows, prototypes and interfaces that turn business rules into usable product, from discovery to implementation with engineering.

items.title: Pentest (Penetration Testing)
items.description: Controlled vulnerability assessment for web, mobile, APIs and networks (VAPT), with a technical report and remediation guidance.

items.title: Red Team
items.description: Advanced offensive security with real-adversary simulation, testing people, process and technology far beyond a traditional pentest.

items.title: Blue Team
items.description: Defensive security with hardening, monitoring, detection, incident response and SOC support to reduce threat impact.

items.title: Purple Team
items.description: Collaborative attack-and-defense exercises to validate controls and improve detection, based on frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

items.title: LGPD / Privacy Compliance
items.description: Privacy and data-protection programs: processing inventories, policies, legal bases, data-subject rights and operational alignment to the law.

items.title: GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance)
items.description: Governance, risk management and compliance with policies, controls, gap analysis and support for standards such as ISO 27001 and NIST.

highlights: SSR/SPA with Nuxt, Vue or React
frontend.about: We build the layer users see and touch: reusable components, routing, state and performance. From design system to continuous delivery, the front becomes a fast, stable product.

mobile.about: From prototype to store: native and cross-platform apps with Flutter or React Native, API integration, push, auth and continuous publishing on iOS and Android.

highlights: Queues, cache and the right databases
backend.about: APIs and services that carry the product: clear contracts, authentication, queues, data and observability. We scale the architecture without losing traceability.

devops.about: From commit to cloud: pipelines, containers, infrastructure as code and safe deploys. Less manual ritual, more repeatability and fast rollback.

architecture.about: We draw the system map: domain boundaries, legacy modernization and integrations. Technical decisions aligned to cost, timeline and security.

uxui.about: We turn business rules into usable flows: research, wireframes, prototypes and engineering handoff. Interfaces that cut friction and speed delivery.

pentest.about: Controlled vulnerability assessment across web, mobile, APIs and networks. You get evidence, impact and a clear remediation path.

redteam.about: We simulate real adversaries across people, process and technology. Beyond pentest, we measure detection, response and resilience under pressure.

blueteam.about: Operational defense: hardening, telemetry, detection and response. We help the SOC see threats early and contain impact with clear playbooks.

purpleteam.about: Attack and defense in one exercise: we validate controls with ATT&CK, tune detection and retest until the signal is trustworthy.

lgpd.about: Privacy in practice: processing maps, legal bases, data-subject rights and operational controls aligned to regulation.

grc.about: Governance, risk and compliance in a continuous loop: policies, controls, gap analysis and support for frameworks like ISO 27001 and NIST.
